messages.subject: Postdoc opening at Trinity College Dublin modeling California deer populations
parts:
Hello, apologies for the late notice on this but I thought this would be a good group to share with - we are looking for a postdoc to join my group at Trinity College Dublin working on deer integrated population modeling in California in collaboration with researchers at UC Berkeley and the California Department of Fish and Wildlife. See attached for more information.

Thank you,
Thomas
